title: Block Entity
description: An associated block-entity will be placed with the intent to provide persistent local metadata, akin to chests, spawners, signs, etc...

dynamic_properties.title: Dynamic Properties
dynamic_properties.description: Enables or disables the storing of DynamicProperties

container.title: Container
container.description: [EXPERIMENTAL] Adds a container to this block.

slot_count.title: Slot Count
slot_count.description: Sets the number of slots in the container.

title.title: Title
title.description: Optional container title, stored as a language file key or raw text.

entity_storage.title: Entity Storage
entity_storage.description: [EXPERIMENTAL] Stores serialized entities in this block via scripting.
